label: Selected q44 source supply by aligning the actual ancestor with p (inference)
rule: Causal-chain induction, explicit reception argument and equality elimination
meaning: For each participant the seven ancestry/composition/reception inputs supply a distinct actual identity ancestor and its own-being causal responsibility. Existing at-most-one actual identity and the selected actual identity witness identify that ancestor with the same p. This is selection of the supplied ancestor, not identification of every possible own-being cause with p. No backwards OwnBeing-to-identity dictionary or IsGod uniqueness is used.
